Name: Roses In The Sand (A Romancable Sandy Expansion)
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QlSoouX.png[/img]
[font=Verdana][b]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=6][u]Roses In The Sand[/u][/size][/color]

[/b][size=3]Roses In The Sand is a NPC expansion for Sandy. It gives her 7 new events (one of which is shared with SVE), makes her fully romanceable, adds hundreds of dialogue lines, expands upon her lore, reveals her true identity, gives her new emotions, expands her schedule, adds her to festivals past 5 hearts, gives her new outfits, gives her a spouse room/area, gives her her own music theme, etc. This mod is not [u]just[/u] for those who want to romance her, as her general dialogue, schedule and heart events have been expanded as well.[/size]

[size=3]Roses In The Sand includes relatively mature themes such as abandonment and depression (Nothing explicit or nsfw) in her backstory and some of her dialogue. Otherwise the dialogue is very tame with a focus on humor and romance.

After marriage Sandy will still go to the Oasis every other day, except Tuesdays when she always will go to Aerobics. [/size]

[size=3]This mod is meant to feature a unique take on Sandy's lore while still fitting with the lore already in the vanilla game and the added lore in SVE [/size](which isn't much)[size=3].

[/size][size=3]This mod is fully compatible with SVE.

[u]Content Warnings!! [/u]
[spoiler]Includes minor mentions of war, abandonment and depression
If you do not want mentions of war, use the alternative 8 heart event as mentioned in the config[/spoiler]
[/size]
[size=3]Big thankyou to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url] for their help with proofreading, help with bugfixing and help with content ideas for the alternative 8 heart event.
[/size]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=5][b]Events[/b][/size][/color]

[spoiler]
Her first heart event is at 2 hearts in the Oasis.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her second heart event is at 4 hearts at the Desert past 5pm (Leave Oasis / Skull Cavern).
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her third heart event is at 5 hearts in the town around midday in sunny weather.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her fourth heart event is at 8 hearts at the Desert past 5pm (Leave Oasis / Skull Cavern). Discusses mature themes.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her fifth heart event is at 9 hearts at the Beach at night after you've received her letter.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her sixth heart event is at 12 hearts in the Casino.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
Her seventh heart event is at 14 hearts after you've received her letter, at night at either the Adventurer's Guild Summit (If SVE) or the beach (If vanilla). Make sure to watch this event to the end for a special one time reward!!!!!
[/spoiler]
[size=5]
[color=#b4a7d6][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/size]

[size=3]This mod includes edited versions of portraits and sprites for Sandy made by Poltergeister so that Sandy can express herself by more than 4 faces.

This mod is only compatible with other mods that give Sandy new portraits if they include the required emotions and outfits.
One example of a portrait mod that works with Roses In The Sand is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18315]Aelinore's Nyapu Misc. Portraits [/url] (Adorable)
For another option, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31078]HanaGee's Ohodavi Sandy Portraits[/url] also work!
Another option for a portrait replacer: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31921]Geru's Portrait's[/url].

[/size][size=3]This mod is fully compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded

This mod is compatible with seasonal cute characters (BUT you have to disable the sandy changes in Seasonal Cute Character's Config)

This mod is probably compatible with Immersive Sandy. If you find out any incompatiblities between the two let me know!

[size=5][color=#b4a7d6][b]Configuration[/b][/color][/size]

[/size][/font][font=Verdana][size=3]If you have other mods which add portraits and/or sprites for Sandy this mod has two configuration options to disable the built in changes. Note that whatever portraits replace them should include the same emotions, and that the sprites that replace them should include the same outfits (Wedding dress and workout outfit)

There is also a config option to change Sandy's "real" name. By default it is [spoiler]Valentina[/spoiler] just because it means [spoiler]"Strength"[/spoiler] which is relevant to her story, but ultimately you can change her name to whatever!

There is also an option to disable her using her "real" name after 8 heart event if you want it to still show as Sandy.

There is also an option to use an alternative version of the 8 heart event removes some potentially triggering content.

[font=Verdana][size=3][size=5][color=#b4a7d6][b]Translations
[/b][/color][/size]
[/size][/font][font=Verdana][size=3]This mod includes a translatable i18n file. If anyone would like to translate the mod they can either send me the translated i18n file or upload the translation file separately with a requirement / credit towards this page. 

[/size][/font][/size][/font]There is currently a Japanese, Chinese, Thai and Spanish translation. These can be found under the "Translations" tab at the top of this page. Thanks to all the wonderful translators!
